turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on word order (subject + verb + object)?
turns.tutor:
Hello! Happy to. The standard pattern is subject + verb + object, then place, then time. Frequency adverbs (always, usually, often) go before the main verb, but after the verb be.
Example: We usually have lunch at one. / She is often late.

Exercise: Put these words in order to make a correct sentence:
often / my aunt / tea / makes / in the afternoon
